title: Resting-to-peak heart-rate reserve does not establish improved cross-hospital angiographic disease discrimination in two public cohorts
abstract: An omitted resting-rate field enabled calculation of achieved heart-rate reserve in public UCI Hungary and independent Long Beach VA data. A conventional clinical/exercise ridge logistic baseline improved source OOF AUC0.8909 to0.8945 but external AUC fell0.7574 to0.7525 (n146; paired delta95%CI[-0.01974,0.01069]; joint refitCI[-0.03346,0.00822]). A small Brier improvement was uncertain. Medication, complete-case, resting-HR, regularization and duplicate-record checks do not establish incremental transfer. AI-performed existing-public-data negative result; not a novel biomarker or clinical recommendation.
